mechanism: Match the three existing central black cells of G to their identical positions in D using a three-color bent-cluster correspondence. Predict D from copying this positional black cluster while omitting the X-to-Y black/white inversion.
design_difference: Old B design compressed the bottom-row 3:1 runs to 2:2. This design instead binds a central bent three-cell feature at exact unchanged row/column positions in G and D; it tests omission of complementation, with no bottom-row grouping or compressed run.
primary_math_proof: Read all sixteen cell fills of X and Y: Y=1-X pointwise. Therefore complement G at the same coordinates. The full four binary rows are G=0010,1100,0110,0001; complement=1101,0011,1001,1110. Full comparison with all five options gives E alone. D copies G unchanged and is wrong in every cell under the complement rule. No fill or border position changes.
